standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.constant: The Huber threshold stays fixed throughout.
optionDescriptions.auto: Chooses its own schedule at runtime.

advanced.principle: constant 固定；exponential/snr 随训练/SNR 变化；auto 按 batch 残差分位估计。

advanced_en.principle: constant = fixed; exponential/snr vary with training progress/SNR; auto estimates from batch residual quantiles.
